Go to http://localhost:7770/catalogsearch/result/?q=Ashcombe . Across the Ashcombe listings, which seller is cheapest for size M, and what is that price? Only count a listing that can actually supply that size.

Before answering, open every listing in the search results, including any on later pages, and check the relevant option on each one. Do not stop early because a listing looks unpromising from its search-result price. Base the answer only on listings you have opened, and say how many you opened.

result.final: The cheapest seller for Ashcombe size M is Copperfield Outfitters at $23.43. I opened all 15 listings in the search results and checked each one for size M availability. Of these, 7 sellers can supply size M: Kelsall Supply ($29.51), Haldane Textiles ($26.21), Northwick Apparel ($28.76), Garrick Collective ($35.81), Copperfield Outfitters ($23.43), Pentland Threads ($26.03), and Oakhurst Apparel ($27.66). The remaining 8 sellers either had size M disabled or did not offer it as an option.
